description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Need" name="Parts needed for contract project">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Query" name="Query web shops for quantity, price and delivery time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateList" name="Create list of parts to order from each web shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderSplit" name="Enough parts at one web shop?" default="Flow_OrderSeveral">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderOne</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderSeveral</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderOne" name="Order cheapest parts from one web shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderOne</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSeveral" name="Order cheapest parts from several web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderSeveral</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Orders placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FirstArrival" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock level of each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Stock level of part?" default="Flow_StockOk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StockOk</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteMail" name="Write mail to friends complaining about web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts from fastest web shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StockOk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_NextBatch" name="Next parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NextBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockExhausted" name="Stock exhausted, web shops complained about">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Need" targetRef="Task_Query"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Query" targetRef="Task_CreateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateList" targetRef="Gateway_OrderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderOne" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderOne">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enough parts at one web shop</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSeveral" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveral"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_OrderOne" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveral" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Catch_FirstArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Catch_FirstArrival" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock > 0 and stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock >= 3 and stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockOk" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_WriteMail" targetRef="End_StockExhausted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Catch_NextBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Catch_NextBatch" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
